summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** **Petition No. 1/RC/2021** **Coram: Shri P.K. Pujari, Chairperson Shri I.S. Jha, Member Shri Arun Goyal, Member Shri P.K. Singh, Member** **Date of Order: 4** **th** **March, 2021** # **In the matter of** Petition for up-gradation of trading licence under Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of trading licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2020. # **And In the matter of** Essar Electric Power Development Corporation Limited ** ..Applicant** # ** ORDER ** This Regulatory Compliance Application has been made by the Essar Electric Power Development Corporation Limited for up-gradation of its inter-State trading licence in electricity to Category-III. 2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner vide his letter dated 25.2.2021 has submitted that subsequent to assessment of the market conditions and business plan of the group, the Petitioner would not be in a position to utilize Category-III licence and would file separate Petition for down-gradation to Category-IV licence in terms of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of trading licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2020. Learned counsel has Order in Petition No. 254/MP/2018 Page 1 sought permission to withdraw the present Regulatory Compliance Application. 3. The prayer of the Petitioner is allowed. However, prayer of the Petitioner to adjust the filing fee of Rs. 50,000/- in Petition to be filed in future is rejected. 4. Accordingly, Petition No. 1/RC/2021 is disposed of as withdrawn. Sd/sd/sd/sd/- **(P.K. Singh) (Arun Goyal) (I.S. Jha) (P.K. Pujari) Member Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 254/MP/2018 Page 2 CERC website S.No. 151/2021
title: Petition for up-gradation of trading licence under Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of trading licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2020. Essar Electric Power Development Corporation Limited
